searchText: <@476250636548308992> we should start to see persistent committee membership evenly spread across all 64 subnets on topaz, right? Yeap we should although it will be a bit slow, most users don't update their nodes that often and we don't have a release tagged with that change yet, so most of the users will be running the old images Ok makes sense. I was going to ask how good they were about updating nodes Are you seeing any persistent committees in topaz now, using your network tool ? I looked yesterday. I saw one node subscribed to 13 and the rest in 0-5. That being said I am only able to consistently discover 200 nodes. ok , it seems like users are slow to update. It should be more obvious in the next few days Cool deal. I'll let you know what I see Does anyone know what testnet this fork_digest belongs to? `28e2f490` I noticed it while crawling topaz yesterday. The fork digests i see are: `f071c66c` - topaz `9925efd6` - schlesi Probably the fork digest I mistakenly created by running prysm with topaz eth1 contract, but schlesi network. Got the wrong genesis state, and had fork digest problems See interop channel in prysm discord gotcha...thanks. I just wanted to make sure it wasn't another testnet i hadn't heard of
